newsitem.title: USA: Ice Miller to take over Carlson and Hug office.
newsitem.headline: Ice Miller to take over Carlson and Hug office.

text.p: The Indianapolis-based bond counsel firm of Ice Miller Donadio & Ryan announced Friday it will open a Chicago office in January by absorbing the practice of Carlson and Hug.
Ice Miller said it hired Charles R. Hug of Carlson and Hug for the new Chicago office and has retained Charles P. Carlson, of counsel to Carlson and Hug.
Thomas K. "Buddy" Downs, chairman of Ice Miller's municipal finance section, said the opportunity for a Chicago office presented itself when Hug started looking to associate with another firm.

"Chuck Carlson and Chuck Hug have established the type of reputation and practice throughout Illinois and the rest of the country that fit perfectly within the culture of Ice Miller and our philosophy of practicing bond law," Downs said.
Also moving to Ice Miller's Chicago office slated to open as of Jan. 1 is Thomas C. Smith, a bond lawyer in Ice Miller's Indianapolis office.
